description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to object storage and management in a version control system, specifically handling loose objects, object info, reading and writing objects, and associated operations.

classes.name: odb_source_loose
classes.description: Represents a source of loose objects within an object database, maintaining caches and maps for object lookup and management.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of an odb_source_loose structure tied to a specific source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_free
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with an odb_source_loose instance.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_reprepare
methods.description: Reinitializes the loose object cache for a source, typically by clearing cached data.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_info
methods.description: Reads metadata information about a specific loose object identified by its object ID.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_read_object_stream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream interface to read the contents of a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_has_object
methods.description: Checks if a provided object ID exists in the loose object source.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_freshen_object
methods.description: Updates the timestamp or state for a specific loose object to indicate recent access.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_object
methods.description: Writes a new loose object to the database with specified data and type.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_write_stream
methods.description: Streams data into the database to create a loose object.

methods.name: odb_source_loose_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache of object IDs associated with the specified object.

methods.name: odb_loose_path
methods.description: Computes the filesystem path for storing or accessing a loose object given its object ID.

methods.name: for_each_loose_file_in_source
methods.description: Iterates over loose object files in the source, invoking callbacks for each file, cruft, or subdirectory.

methods.name: for_each_loose_object
methods.description: Iterates over all loose objects accessible in the repository.

methods.name: format_object_header
methods.description: Creates the header string for a loose object, indicating its type and size.

methods.name: force_object_loose
methods.description: Forces creation or update of a loose object with a given modification time.

methods.name: check_object_signature
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of an object by checking its hash signature against its contents.

methods.name: stream_object_signature
methods.description: Streams an object’s data from the repository and verifies its integrity simultaneously.

methods.name: finalize_object_file
methods.description: Completes the process of storing an object file, ensuring it is properly linked and verified.

methods.name: hash_object_file
methods.description: Computes the hash over the contents of an object file, producing its object ID.

methods.name: check_and_freshen_file
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a file and updates its timestamp if necessary.

methods.name: read_loose_object
methods.description: Reads a loose object’s data, validates its hash and returns its contents and metadata.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_begin
methods.description: Begins a batch transaction for adding multiple objects atomically.

methods.name: object_file_transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits the current batch transaction, making all added objects visible.

ctags.name: each_loose_cruft_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(const char * basename,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: each_loose_object_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: each_loose_subdir_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int ()(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
